# Semantic Versioning Expected Format

The version string must be in the format MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, where each component is an integer.

To ensure that only valid and parseable semantic versions are processed when bumping project versions.

**Anchored to:**

- `scripts/release.py` — `scripts.release.bump`
